name: VolunteerProjectCardLinks - Both Detail Only And Apply Only
description: The three link combinations a real grid produces: both, detail-page link only for a project with no sign-up form yet, and apply-only for a card rendered without a slug. The two levels of the site's button system side by side: Read the full description → is the small shared link, and Get involved is a solid pill with no arrow because it is the card's main action. Stacked, with the pill last so it closes the card.
